articles.headline: Jordan deliver the Socceroos a much-needed wake-up call
articles.description: Australia's loss to Jordan will probably emphasise the importance of soul-searching and reflection more than a win would have, spurring an honest appraisal of where the side presently is, where it needs to be, and how it can get there.

images.name: Yengi Socceroos [1296x729]
images.caption: Everything that the Socceroos had done right in their 3-0 win over Qatar last week was effectively inverted against Jordan.

images.name: Socceroos earn comfortable win against Qatar
images.caption: Australia emerges with a 3-0 victory over Qatar in a turnover-ridden friendly.

articles.headline: Socceroos suffer loss, now wait for Popovic decision
articles.description: If this is to be goodbye, it was not a good one, with Tony Popovic's Socceroos deservedly beaten 2-0 in Qatar by a Jordanian side that had not previously won in 2026 but were hungrier and sharper.

images.name: Harry Souttar [1296x729]
images.caption: Popovic described the first period as "terrible".

articles.headline: Vinícius Júnior hits hat trick as Brazil beat Singapore 7-0
articles.description: Vinícius Júnior scored a first-half hat trick on Tuesday as Brazil thrashed Singapore 7-0 in its final game of 2026.

articles.headline: Football Australia: No cost blowout associated with Jordan fixture relocation
articles.description: Football Australia chief executive Martin Kugeler has told ESPN the federation won't face a cost blowout after the Socceroos friendly with Jordan was moved from Amman to Doha in Qatar.

images.name: Martin Kugeler [1296x729]
images.caption: Martin Kugeler has denied Football Australia will incur a cost blowout for moving the friendly against Jordan to Qatar.
